uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

6867-7042-7117.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison.
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0} due to Aang.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian.
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

728-1818-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
728-1818-5010-6900.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2557-4365-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2292-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

5035-5104-5686.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-5686.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

1263-4871-5686-6248.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1563-4785-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-4785-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-4785-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2511-6602--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

3991-4605-6798-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2034-2919-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-2034-2919-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3459-5078-5243-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3750-4050-7026.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten legendary enchantments.
3750-4050-7026.description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar ten times by sacrificing ten Spirits, adding {3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-4050-7026.notes: You can also tap creatures you control to help pay for the costs of this combo, reducing the number of legendary enchantments you need to control.

5299-5399-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Pirated Copy
5299-5399-5466.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Pirated Copy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Pirated Copy's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Pirated Copy's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Pirated Copy's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5034-5131-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5034-5131-6797.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sol Ring
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

2-2034-6518.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {2}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, failing to destroy Ancestral Statue as it isn't on the battlefield and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Druid, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2665-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Progenitor Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
2665-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Progenitor Mimic.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Progenitor Mimic.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

359-372-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-4125.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-2072-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2072-4477.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

586-2292-4314-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

578-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Metalworker does not have summoning sickness. You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-2608-4499.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least two artifact cards from your hand and adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

4131-4694-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4694-4893.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2063-2498-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2063-2498-4691.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Mischievous Poltergeist abilities.

618-3381-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Morgue Toad with haste.
Activate the Morgue Toad token by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1636-2034-4319-4424.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
1636-2034-4319-4424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

1636-3149-3730-3828.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one untapped Wolf.
Master of the Wild Hunt does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3149-3730-3828.description:
Activate Master of the Wild by tapping it, tapping all untapped Wolves you control, then causing them to deal damage to the creature with Druid's Call attached equal to their power, then having the creature with Druid's Call attached deal damage to the Wolves equal to its power.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to the damage dealt.
When the Squirrel(s) enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

172-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 50 minus your storm count.
172-4740.description:
Cast Skilled Animator by paying {2}{U}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
When Skilled Animator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become a 5/5 artifact creature.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 5.

3957-4481.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Famished Paladin.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
3957-4481.description:
Give Famished Paladin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and causing you to gain 2 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-186-1812-2005.notablePrerequisites: Jetfire has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
114-186-1812-2005.description:
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} and converting it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Prismite three times by paying {3}, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {U}{U}{U}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Repeat.

1124-3836-4659-4853-5002.notablePrerequisites: Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
1124-3836-4659-4853-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's third loyalty ability by putting no loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Soldiers die, triggering Dross Scorpion twice, untapping The Chain Veil and any other artifact you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

1558-3049.notablePrerequisites:
Sophina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four other creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1558-3049.description:
Declare Sophina and at least four other creatures as attackers.
Sophina triggers, creating at least five Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Clue tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2447-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Infested Werewolf.
Infested Werewolf enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing both Insect tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

132-2645-5116.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-5116.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

239-1636-1763-2273.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Sliver.
An additional Sliver with mana value 1 in library.
239-1636-1763-2273.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for a Sliver with mana value 1.
Cast that Sliver by paying {1}.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat, gaining {1} more each time in step 1 and searching for a Sliver costing up to {1} more each time in step 2.

224-1362-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
